name: Do I need to get permits for bathroom threshold removal and curbless shower conversion in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to get permits for bathroom threshold removal and curbless shower conversion in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, in many municipalities across the Bay Area, including cities like San Francisco, Daly City, or South San Francisco, you will likely need permits for a bathroom threshold removal and curbless shower conversion. This type of renovation often involves changes to plumbing, structural elements, and waterproofing systems, all of which are typically subject to local building codes and inspections. Obtaining the necessary permits ensures that the work meets safety standards and is compliant with local regulations. We can assist with navigating the permitting process.
